description:
Find campgrounds similar to a given campground using vector embedding similarity.

Uses pre-computed embeddings combining review text (semantic) and structured attributes
(amenities, terrain, activities) for nuanced similarity matching.

campground_id.description: CUID of the target campground to find similar ones for

max_distance_km.description: Optional max distance in km (omit for nationwide search)

name: find_similar_campgrounds
title: Find Similar Campgrounds
